verdict.rationale: The evidence shows privacy controls for restricting routing to providers by data policy, and an account-wide setting for allowing providers that may train on your data. These are adjacent controls over third-party provider logging and training, not an opt-out of OpenRouter's own telemetry or usage tracking. Nothing in the pack documents disabling OpenRouter's own analytics or usage tracking, so the applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
